data.title: Order restricting operating hours for the wood splitting machine
data.summary: The Untere Immissionsschutzbehörde of Kreis Musterlenne-Sauerland ordered Ilka Musterlenne, following measurements at the neighbouring house that exceeded noise limits, to only operate her wood splitting machine on weekdays between 9–12 and 15–18, with no operation on Sundays or public holidays. A court action (Klage) against this decision can be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The local environmental authority (Untere Immissionsschutzbehörde) has limited when you may run your wood splitter because noise measurements at the neighbour's house exceeded allowed limits. You must now keep to the permitted hours (weekdays 9–12 and 15–18, none on Sundays/public holidays). If you disagree with the order, you may file a court action (Klage) at the Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg; the app shows the deadline for this. If you take no action by the deadline shown, the order becomes final and you must continue following the restricted hours. Consider seeking legal advice if you want to contest it.
